knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)

# Load libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(sleuth)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(RankProd)
```

# Load sample metadata
```{r}
s2c <- read_csv(here("Raw","results","run_metadata.txt")) %>% 
  mutate(path = gsub("/abundance.tsv", "", paste0(here("Raw","results"), "/", path)),
         name = gsub("_0h_\\d$", "", name),
         sample = paste0(name, "_",  timepoint, "_", biorep),
         name = factor(name),
         timepoint = factor(timepoint),
         biorep = factor(biorep)
         ) %>%
  mutate(
    experiment = if_else(name %in% c("pmk1", "Guy11M"), "Exp2", "Exp1"),
    experiment = factor(experiment, levels = c("Exp1", "Exp2"))
  )
```

# Helper: extract TPM matrix from kallisto outputs for a set of samples
```{r}
get_tpm_matrix <- function(s2c_subset) {
  tpm_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(s2c_subset)), function(i) {
    abund_file <- file.path(s2c_subset$path[i], "abundance.tsv")
    tpm <- read_tsv(abund_file, col_types = cols()) %>%
      select(target_id, tpm) %>%
      rename(!!s2c_subset$sample[i] := tpm)
    tpm
  })
  
  tpm_mat <- reduce(tpm_list, full_join, by = "target_id")
  rownames_mat <- tpm_mat$target_id
  
  # Drop target_id and force numeric matrix
  tpm_mat <- tpm_mat %>%
    select(-target_id) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  rownames(tpm_mat) <- rownames_mat
  
  # Sanity checks
  stopifnot(is.numeric(tpm_mat))
  stopifnot(ncol(tpm_mat) == nrow(s2c_subset))
  
  # Ensure column order matches s2c_subset row order
  tpm_mat <- tpm_mat[, s2c_subset$sample, drop = FALSE]
  
  message("TPM matrix: ", nrow(tpm_mat), " features x ", ncol(tpm_mat), " samples")
  message("Columns: ", paste(colnames(tpm_mat), collapse = ", "))
  
  return(tpm_mat)
}
```

# Core rank products function
```{r}
run_rank_products <- function(s2c_all,
                              group1_name,   # treated / "condition" group
                              group2_name,   # reference / "control" group
                              timepoint_filter = NULL,
                              out_dir = here("Analysis/Data/DGE/RankProducts"),
                              logged = FALSE,   # set TRUE if data already log-transformed
                              num_perm = 100) {
  
  # Filter to just these two strains
  s2c_sub <- s2c_all %>%
    filter(name %in% c(group1_name, group2_name))
  
  if (!is.null(timepoint_filter)) {
    s2c_sub <- s2c_sub %>% filter(timepoint == timepoint_filter)
  }
  
  s2c_sub <- s2c_sub %>% droplevels()
  
  if (nrow(s2c_sub) == 0) {
    warning("No samples found for this combination.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  message("Samples included:")
  print(s2c_sub %>% select(sample, name, timepoint, biorep))
  
  # Build TPM matrix
  tpm_mat <- get_tpm_matrix(s2c_sub)
  
  # log2(TPM + 0.5) transform (matches your sleuth transformation)
  expr_mat <- log2(tpm_mat + 0.5)
  
  # Class vector: 1 = group1 (condition), 0 = group2 (reference)
  # Must use 0/1 for RankProd
  cl <- ifelse(s2c_sub$name == group1_name, 1, 0)
  
  # Origin vector: which experiment each sample comes from
  origin <- as.integer(s2c_sub$experiment)
  
  message("Class vector: ", paste(cl, collapse = ", "))
  message("Origin vector: ", paste(origin, collapse = ", "))
  message(
    "n samples: ", nrow(s2c_sub),
    "  (", group1_name, ": ", sum(cl == 1),
    ", ", group2_name, ": ", sum(cl == 0), ")"
  )
  
  # Final checks before RP
  stopifnot(is.matrix(expr_mat))
  stopifnot(is.numeric(expr_mat))
  stopifnot(length(cl) == ncol(expr_mat))
  message("expr_mat dims: ", nrow(expr_mat), " x ", ncol(expr_mat))
  message("Class table: "); print(table(cl))
  
  # Run Rank Products
  # gene.names = rownames (transcript/gene IDs)
  # logged = TRUE because we've already log-transformed
  # na.rm = TRUE to handle any missing values
  rp_result <- RP(
    data       = expr_mat,
    cl         = cl,
    num.perm   = num_perm,
    logged     = TRUE,   # data is log2 transformed
    na.rm      = TRUE,
    gene.names = rownames(expr_mat),
    plot       = FALSE
  )
  
  # topGene returns both directions in one call in this version of RankProd
  tg <- topGene(rp_result, cutoff = 1, method = "pfp",
                logged = TRUE, logbase = 2,
                gene.names = rownames(expr_mat))
  
  # Table1 = upregulated in group1, Table2 = upregulated in group2
  tidy_table <- function(tbl, direction) {
    if (is.null(tbl) || nrow(tbl) == 0) return(NULL)
    as.data.frame(tbl) %>%
      rownames_to_column("target_id") %>%
      mutate(direction = direction)
  }
  
  res_df <- bind_rows(
    tidy_table(tg$Table1, paste0("up_in_", group1_name)),
    tidy_table(tg$Table2, paste0("up_in_", group2_name))
  ) %>%
    arrange(pfp)
  
  # Save
  tp_str <- if (!is.null(timepoint_filter)) paste0(timepoint_filter, "H_") else ""
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  out_file <- file.path(out_dir,
                        paste0("rankprod_", tp_str,
                               group1_name, "_vs_", group2_name, ".csv"))
  write_csv(res_df, out_file)
  message("Results written to: ", out_file)
  
  return(res_df)
}
```

# Run comparisons per timepoint
```{r}
timepoints <- levels(s2c$timepoint)

# --- pmk1 vs mst7 ---
# pmk1 is Exp2, mst7 is Exp1 -- they come from separate experiments
# Rank products handles this via the origin vector (experiment membership)
results_pmk1_vs_mst7 <- lapply(timepoints, function(tp) {
  message("\n=== pmk1 vs mst7 | Timepoint: ", tp, "H ===")
  run_rank_products(
    s2c_all         = s2c,
    group1_name     = "pmk1",
    group2_name     = "mst7",
    timepoint_filter = tp
  )
})
names(results_pmk1_vs_mst7) <- timepoints

# --- Guy11 vs Guy11M ---
# Guy11 is Exp1, Guy11M is Exp2 -- again separate experiments
results_Guy11_vs_Guy11M <- lapply(timepoints, function(tp) {
  message("\n=== Guy11 vs Guy11M | Timepoint: ", tp, "H ===")
  run_rank_products(
    s2c_all         = s2c,
    group1_name     = "Guy11",
    group2_name     = "Guy11M",
    timepoint_filter = tp
  )
})
names(results_Guy11_vs_Guy11M) <- timepoints
```

# Quick summary of significant hits (pfp < 0.05)
```{r}
summarise_hits <- function(res_list, comparison_label, pfp_cutoff = 0.05) {
  message("\n--- ", comparison_label, " ---")
  for (tp in names(res_list)) {
    res <- res_list[[tp]]
    if (is.null(res) || nrow(res) == 0) {
      message("Timepoint ", tp, "H: no results")
      next
    }
    sig <- res %>% filter(pfp < pfp_cutoff)
    message("Timepoint ", tp, "H: ", nrow(sig), " significant genes (pfp < ", pfp_cutoff, ")")
    if (nrow(sig) > 0) print(head(sig, 10))
  }
}

summarise_hits(results_pmk1_vs_mst7,   "pmk1 vs mst7")
summarise_hits(results_Guy11_vs_Guy11M, "Guy11 vs Guy11M")
```
